researchEvidence.primaryStudy: G2-07 Practical Comeback / Reply-Pressure Representation Study 1

mechanism.name: exact single-reply opponent-cutoff one-ply extension
mechanism.lifetime: candidate state exists only within one analyzeMove call

runtimeTrigger.location: enhancedSearch after terminal check and exactly when nominal depth remaining is 0, before baseline quiescence return
runtimeTrigger.condition: feature enabled AND state is nonterminal AND state.player differs from root player AND exact E.moveVariants(state).length == 1

extensionSemantics.extensionLength: exactly one ordinary legal move ply
extensionSemantics.forcedMove: the sole exact legal move variant returned by E.moveVariants(state)
extensionSemantics.application: apply the sole move with E.applyMove, then immediately evaluate the resulting child through the same quiescence function that baseline would use at the nominal cutoff
extensionSemantics.evaluator: same evaluator instance as nominal search
extensionSemantics.quiescenceDepth: same configured quiescenceDepth as nominal search
extensionSemantics.deadline: same existing analyzeMove deadline; no added milliseconds
extensionSemantics.ttInteraction: no additional TT lookup/store is introduced by the extension itself; the forced child is handed directly to quiescence
extensionSemantics.maximumEnforcement: structural: the candidate cutoff branch returns directly from child quiescence and does not re-enter candidate enhancedSearch
extensionSemantics.timeoutBehavior: quiescence uses the existing deadline and propagates the existing timeout behavior; no fallback budget is added
extensionSemantics.illegalOrAmbiguousReplyAction: candidate trigger is false unless exact legal move variant count equals one

candidateDiagnostics.surface: stats.pbaiC009 only when feature flag is true

requiredExactEquality: all pre-existing stats fields and values

candidateSpecificPopulation.developmentReuseBoundary: the common PBAI-P2 development block may be reused across candidates; C009 selection and gates are fixed independently of C008 per-root outcomes and no C008 row-level result is an input

runtimeEligibleTarget.definition: frozen baseline hard/enhanced/bao D3 completes and its actual nominal enhanced-search execution visits at least one nonterminal opponent-to-root-player depth-zero cutoff with exact legal move variant count == 1
runtimeEligibleTarget.selection: outcome/value/consequence-blind deterministic SHA-256 ranking from the frozen global development root universe, with phase balance as target and deterministic fallback fill
runtimeEligibleTarget.insufficientDevelopmentSupportAction: DEVELOPMENT-NON-ESTIMABLE-HOLD; no replacement source block after inspection

negativeControl.definition: frozen baseline D3 completes and visits zero such single-reply opponent cutoff states
negativeControl.selection: deterministic SHA-256 rank, phase balance target with deterministic fallback fill
negativeControl.purpose: trigger-zero and feature-on search-semantic no-op control

candidateSpecificBenefitGate.reference: PBAI-P2 frozen D4 engineering comparison reference; not game-theoretic truth
candidateSpecificBenefitGate.comparison: feature-off baseline D3 versus feature-on candidate D3 on the same frozen eligible development roots

fixedDepthCostGate.nodeRatioDefinition: candidate cumulative stats.nodes / feature-off baseline cumulative stats.nodes for the D3 analyzeMove call

failureSemantics.developmentPass: VALIDATION-CONTRACT-FREEZE-AUTHORIZED; validation still not executable until separately frozen

rollback.preAdoption: feature flag false reproduces frozen AI-GEN2 behavior
